item.title: The eclipse that nearly no one saw
item.description: An annular solar eclipse, also known as a "ring of fire" eclipse, was visible in Antarctica, with a partial eclipse observed in the southern tip of South America and across the southeast corner of Africa and Madagascar, while the next total solar eclipse visible in the U.S. will occur in 2044.

item.title: Sunnier weather to deliver near record highs ahead a late winter cold snap
item.description: Cloudy skies hindered highs today, but Wednesday should be much brighter and warmer, with temperatures running 10 to 15° above normal, and Thursday could bring record-breaking warmth before cooler weather and a cold snap move in over the weekend.

item.title: From the KOLR archive: Rev. Jesse Jackson visits Springfield in 1981
